message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and niche horror films that have earned a reputation for being genuinely scary or unsettling:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick’s masterful psychological horror with iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A chilling family drama that escalates into supernatural dread. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart blend of social commentary and genuine terror. |
| 4 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological horror that turns grief into a monster. |
| 5 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence is the main weapon—tension builds with every footstep. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A modern take on the “invisible stalker” trope. |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror that turns a festival into a nightmare. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A well‑crafted supernatural thriller based on real‑life investigators. |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Slow‑burn, atmospheric dread set in 17th‑century New England. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage style that makes the supernatural feel immediate. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | A modern retelling of a cursed videotape that haunts viewers. |
|12 | **The Others** | 2001 | A gothic mystery with a twist that keeps you guessing. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑take that subverts horror tropes while still delivering scares. |
|14 | **The Descent** | 2005 | A claustrophobic, gore‑heavy cave‑exploration horror. |
|15 | **Suspiria** (2018) | 2018 | A visually striking remake that blends dance, witchcraft, and dread. |

Feel free to pick any that match your taste—whether you prefer psychological dread, supernatural chills, or visceral gore. Enjoy the fright!
